title: Add an opt-in bounded streaming-read API for remote storage backends
author: dralley
body_preview: ## Problem  `Storage.open()` returns a seekable Django file object. For the django-storages S3, Azure, and GCS backends, opening a file for reading currently materializes the complete remote object into a temporary file before the caller receives data.
